title: SRO Evidence Record
description: Every meaningful action produces one of these. The status field is the epistemic status and cannot be self-assigned: an OBSERVED record is only creatable by EvidenceStore.record_observation, which requires a real tool result. Only the verifier may write VERIFIED, REJECTED or INCONCLUSIVE.

status.description: OBSERVED: a tool did this. INFERRED: SRO derived it from observations. HYPOTHESIS: an agent proposed it, unproven. VERIFIED: the verifier confirmed it against cited observations.

actor.description: Who created the record: 'tool', 'sro', or a named agent/verifier.

tool.description: Required for OBSERVED. An observation without a tool is refused.

request.description: What was sent. Bounded and redacted before storage.

response.description: What came back. Bounded and redacted before storage.

policy.description: The policy decision that permitted the action, stored with the evidence it authorised.

redacted.description: True when secrets were stripped before storage.
